Supports the default `tkzDefLine(A,B)` and explicit `tkzDefLine[mediator](A,B)` by returning the two ordered equilateral-triangle points on the perpendicular bisector; `K` scales their midpoint vectors and `normed` makes each vector exactly `K` centimeters. Supports `tkzDefCircle[circum](A,B,C)` by returning the circumcenter, the first input as a circumference point, and a numeric construction length. Supports `tkzDefCircle[in](A,B,C)` with the native side-length-weighted incenter, a perpendicular tangent point on the first/third input side, and the inradius; local tkz-euclide draws circles through that returned tangent point rather than directly from the legacy `[R]` radius syntax. Supports `tkzDefLine[bisector](P,V,Q)` through the same duplicate-segment and midpoint geometry as TeX Live, and `tkzDefLine[bisector out](P,V,Q)` by rotating that native construction +90 degrees around `V`; `K` rescales either resulting vertex vector and `normed` uses `K` as its final length. Supports `tkzDefLine[symmedian](P,V,Q)` by reflecting the opposite-side midpoint across the unscaled internal bisector at `V`, then applying native `K`/`normed` vector semantics. Supports `tkzDefLine[altitude](P,V,Q)` by projecting the middle point `V` to the `P--Q` line, matching the native branch which deliberately ignores `K` and `normed`. Supports `tkzDefLine[euler](A,B,C)` by constructing the orthocenter from two projected altitude lines and the nine-point center from the circumcenter of the side midpoints; it publishes the native `(orthocenter,nine-point center)` `tkzGetPoints` order and leaves `tkzPointResult` at the nine-point center. Supports `tkzDefLine[tangent at=A](O)` through TeX Live's fixed one-centimeter clockwise normal from `A`, and `tkzDefLine[tangent from=E](O,A)` through its ordered pair of contact points; both share the same external tangent geometry as `tkzTangent[from with R=E](O,radius)`, while the `tangent from` branch keeps the native midpoint in `tkzPointResult`. The real interior/exterior-angle triangle verifies `tkzMarkAngle` single/triple arcs and proportional `tkzDrawLine[add=a and b]` extensions against tikztosvg. It also supports circle-through-point, orthogonal-through circles using inversion plus a circumcenter, line-circle intersections with node/radius/with-nodes inputs and native default/near/common/next-to ordering, external-point tangents with `from with R`, native 0.2pt black!50 circle defaults, `tkzSetUpLabel` and `tkzSetUpStyle` label-style replacement shared by point and segment labels, plural angle/point labels, single/plural segment labels with native default `below,font=\normalsize` and direct TikZ placement options, equality marks x/|/||/|||/s|/s||/s|||/z/s/oo on decorated angle arcs and segments, normal square plus German arc-and-dot right-angle marks, and `tkzFillAngle(s)` sectors with default 10% line-color fill, `size`, `fill`, `draw`, and opacity options.
